name: @maviapi/mcp

tools.name: search_apis
tools.description: Find a ready-made maviapi API for a website or topic, e.g. "hotels", "flights", "booking.com" or "turkish news". maviapi turns websites that have no official API into structured JSON endpoints, and monitors and repairs them when the site changes. Leave `query` empty to list every API. Next step: get_api, to see an API's endpoints and parameters.

query.description: Website, domain, or topic to look for. Empty lists everything.

tools.name: get_api
tools.description: Show one maviapi API's endpoints: what each returns, its parameters (required ones marked), and the fields in the response. Accepts the API slug from search_apis, or the site's domain (e.g. "airbnb.com"). Read this before call_api.

api.description: API slug (e.g. "booking") or the site's domain.

tools.name: call_api
tools.description: Fetch live, structured JSON from a website through a maviapi endpoint. `api` is the API slug (or domain), `endpoint` the endpoint name or path from get_api, and `params` its parameters, path parameters such as {id} included. List endpoints return 10 results unless you pass `limit`; page with `offset`. Each successful call uses one maviapi credit.

api.description: API slug (e.g. "booking") or the site's domain.

params.description: Endpoint parameters, as listed by get_api.

tools.name: create_api
tools.description: Start an API draft for a website that no catalog API covers. maviapi's build agent studies the site and builds a JSON API from a plain-language description. This returns a request_id at once; follow it with get_build_status. Build completion does not publish the API. Use your own account and key to review and publish the draft in the dashboard. With the shared demo key each network gets 3 free builds per 30 days.

description.description: The data wanted from the site, as specific as you can: pages, fields, filters. E.g. "front-page stories with title, url, points, comment count and author".

build_anyway.description: Build even though the catalog already has an API for this site (it lacks what you need).

tools.name: get_build_status
tools.description: Progress of a build started with create_api: queued, building, deploying, published, or failed. The build status published means the build completed, not that the API is publicly available. Checks catalog visibility separately; the owner reviews and publishes drafts in the dashboard. Check back every few minutes rather than in a tight loop.

instructions:
maviapi gives you live, structured JSON from websites that have no official API (travel, e-commerce, news, events, finance and more).
Workflow: search_apis to find an API for a site or topic, get_api to read its endpoints and parameters, then call_api to fetch data.
If no API covers the site you need, create_api builds one (about half an hour; follow it with get_build_status).
